scope.requested: All 242 tools from tools-manifest.json and sitemap.xml

browser.requested: in-app browser tools via code mode (browser skill loaded first)
browser.fallback: playwright-core 1.x driving installed Google Chrome headless from C:/Program Files/Google/Chrome/Application/chrome.exe
browser.fallback_reason: Both in-app browser MCP servers reported no connected desktop/extension browser; no in-app snapshots or screenshots were possible.

gsc_note: The 16-month range was selected in the UI, but the chart and totals still began on 17 Sep 2026, indicating that this is the available data window for the property. Query and page rows were read from the DOM after setting rows per page to 100. CSV export produced no downloaded file, so DOM extraction is the evidence method.
priority_rules: HIGH when exact tool URL has GSC impressions > 0 in the 16-month JSON
HIGH for AI Write tools (recently expanded guide/tool set)
MEDIUM for SEO/Developer tools and remaining core tools

per_tool: fill or dispatch synthetic valid sample inputs (including generated PNG/PDF/WAV/TXT fixtures for file inputs)
click up to 3 visible primary action buttons
clear first editable input and re-click to check empty-input handling
click Copy affordance when present and read clipboard
HEAD-check up to 20 unique same-origin links and inspect broken images
collect console errors and same-origin failed requests
method.depth: Automated single-scenario smoke test plus empty-input re-test; not an exhaustive validation matrix.

limitations: In-app browser tools were disconnected; all interactive rows used a local headless Chrome fallback, so no in-app browser screenshots, snapshots, console tabs, or network tabs are attached.
Testing used the repository's static files on 127.0.0.1:8767, not the production deployment; Cloudflare headers, production CDN behaviour, ads, and server-side endpoints were not exercised.

File fixtures are synthetic: 1x1 PNG, minimal generated PDF, 0.1s WAV, and small text files. Video/heic fixtures may be insufficient; such rows are marked NOT TESTED/PARTIAL where no observable output was produced.
PDF tools that call a lazy-loaded library before awaiting EwtLibs.load may report 'pdfjsLib is not defined'; these are recorded as observed FAIL conditions in this local run.
Copy was clicked where present with clipboard permission granted; Download buttons were detected but not clicked to avoid uncontrolled file side effects.
Console errors from third-party ad scripts or external hosts are recorded verbatim but are not treated as tool failures; same-origin 4xx/failed requests and broken images/links are listed separately.
GSC data window in the source JSON is limited (see gsc_note); priority reflects that window only.
No full npm build was run, no tracked files were modified, and no git staging/commit/push was performed.
